title: The Kiln Street Bulletin
key_sentences: After two wet winters and a long search for a contractor, work on the roofs of numbers 2 to 18 started on 5 October.
Residents whose homes are covered by scaffolding will receive a letter a week before it goes up.
Any member who has lived in the co-operative for at least a year can be nominated.
This year we have three hundred bulbs to plant, so bring gloves, a trowel and a friend on 7 November.
At the general meeting members agreed a rent increase of 2.8%, below the limit set by the housing regulator.
The full minutes can be borrowed from the office or read on the noticeboard.

list_items.text: 1) to replace the entry-phone system at numbers 20 to 36 next spring;
2) to give the youth club the use of the community room on Friday evenings;
3) to set aside £1,500 for new bicycle stands near the garden gate.
